title: Mean of a first-coordinate sign
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $(X,Y)$ be the correlated pair of sign vectors on $\{\pm1\}^n$ obtained by choosing $X$ uniformly and applying independent coordinate noise with retention probability $(1+\rho)/2$. For every coordinate $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$, the expected value of $X_i$ is zero.
